sloka: सिक्ता रुधिर धाराभिः संहत्य परम द्विपाः ।प्रचरन्ति पृथक् कीर्णा मेघ वर्णाः तरस्विनः ॥३-७३-३६॥
transliteration: siktā rudhira dhārābhiḥ saṁhatya parama dvipāḥ ।pracaranti pṛthak kīrṇā megha varṇāḥ tarasvinaḥ ॥3-73-36॥

translations.english: The great, nimble elphants, dark like clouds, drenched with the flow of ichor come together and then separate and scatter.
